# DataDashOS — full summary for AI crawlers

Canonical site: https://simmitri-inc.github.io/datadashos-site/
Contact: hello@datadashos.com

## Positioning
DataDashOS is a KPI-first operating system for growing businesses. Instead of starting with dashboards, it starts by deciding which numbers define success, then builds a weekly rhythm of review and action around them.

Tagline: KPIs first. Everything else follows.

## How it works
1. Define — Recommend KPIs for your industry, model, goals and stage.
2. Track — One scorecard for the whole business.
3. Manage — Weekly AI review turns numbers into owned actions.
4. Adapt — KPIs grow as the business grows.

## What's inside
- KPI scorecard with industry blueprints, targets, trends, notes and forecasts
- Dashboards for executive, marketing, sales and operations
- Weekly reviews with AI-written summaries and tracked actions
- AI business coach grounded in your KPIs
- Data connections for QuickBooks Online, GoHighLevel, Google Ads, plus CSV import
- Teams and admin: workspaces, roles, invitations, audit logs, branding

## Who it's for
Owners, CEOs, leadership teams, and growing businesses that have outgrown spreadsheets but do not want a BI project.

## FAQ
Q: Does it replace existing software?
A: No. It sits on top of accounting, CRM and marketing tools.

Q: How is it different from a BI dashboard?
A: BI shows data. DataDashOS defines what to measure, then turns numbers into weekly decisions and owned actions.

Q: Can I use it today?
A: Early access opens in waves. Join the waitlist.

## Integrity
Product screens show sample data and are never presented as customer results.
